0aeaa49b85db9c8c13e276ec3ab379b6b7a3477c feat: add edit-intent classification and prediction-based tool blocking

- Introduce regex-based detectEditSignal classifier with haiku LLM fallback for ambiguous user prompts
- Implement prediction-cache to track expected tools and block misaligned non-edit tools
- Integrate edit-intent checks into PreToolUse pipeline with appeals and session state persistence
- Extend gate agent context to include editIntent and tool predictions
- Update agent configs, hook logic, and README with new edit-intent agent
